metadata.description: Seattle-area general-market rental apartment communities with dedicated leasing websites and shared amenities.

criteria.area: Any city within the driving-time limit of South Lake Union, Seattle
criteria.rental_type: Whole rental apartment community; exclude individually owned condominium buildings.
criteria.leasing_website: A dedicated property website or operator-hosted page must provide rental listings, availability or an official vacancy channel that reports no available units.
criteria.eligibility: Open general-market rentals. Optional income-restricted units are allowed; primarily income-restricted or population-restricted housing is excluded.

methodology.coordinates: Google Maps Geocoding API using street addresses as inputs.
methodology.routing: Google Routes API DRIVE with TRAFFIC_UNAWARE; shortest returned static duration among default and alternative routes, from the SLU reference point to each property. No live traffic or departure time.
methodology.unknown_values: Unverified construction years and management companies are null.
methodology.sources: Per-property source URLs document the facts each source supports.
methodology.vacancy_status: Buildings may be fully leased. The directory requires an official, functioning vacancy channel even when no unit is available on the research date.
methodology.coverage: The directory covers all 195 original entries and additional properties researched by neighborhood. It does not cover every qualifying Seattle-area building.
